impact: Any OpenAI markdown or funding strain would hit AI infrastructure sentiment including NBIS and MSFT; a strong print supports the AI rebound.
summary: SoftBank Group reports fiscal Q2 results at 06:30 GMT Tuesday. Forecasts range from a 233B yen profit to a 113B yen loss; its cumulative OpenAI investment is about $64.6B (about 13%), and it faces roughly $30B of OpenAI-related obligations in the second half of 2026.
title: SoftBank reports Q2 today, $64.6B OpenAI stake in focus
